newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul Exchange to list shares of carpet maker.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul Exchange to list shares of carpet maker.

text.p: The Istanbul Stock Exchange said it would list shares representing 17.78 percent of the capital of leading carpet maker Gumussuyu Hali ve Yer Kaplamalari Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. on the national market on Tuesday.
It said the opening price would be 1,600 lira per 1,000 lira nominal-valued share.
The company had offered 800 billion lira worth of shares to the public on January 23-24 as part of a move to raise its capital to 4.5 trillion lira from 3.7 trillion.

Lead-manager Korfez investment said 17 foreign institutional investors had bought 360 billion lira of the total offer, 29,024 domestic investors bought 320 billion lira and 55 domestic institutions the remaining 120 billion.
Gumussuyu reported 442.63 billion lira of profit before tax and 1.78 trillion lira of net sales in the first nine months of 1996 when it produced 7.91 million square metres of carpets.

The company has a total annual carpet weaving capacity of 16 million square metres, including six million square metres of wilton, five million square metres of tufting and five million square metres of non-woven types.

In addition to ongoing capacity expansion and modernisation investments worth a total of $8.8 million, Gumussuyu plans to spend an additional $18 million on new capacity enlargement projects and fund 80 percent of the investments internally.
